svg.title: A Screening Funnel, Not an Award Forecast
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nested-retainer-conversion; chart type: funnel; title: A Screening Funnel, Not an Award Forecast; subtitle: Nested illustrative cohorts end in paid firm-matter engagements; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Synthetic mature-year cohort, not measured conversion history. All stages count distinct firm-matter opportunities, each anchored to an initial signal; later stages are subsets of earlier stages. Five engagements belong to five separate firms. No conversion stage represents an agency recovery probability.; caption: Sequential conversion is 18.0%, 33.3%, 30.0%, and 27.8%; overall conversion is 0.5%. Annual engagement fees of $60,000, $75,000, $90,000, $112,500, and $150,000 total $487,500. This is a mature annual service model, not a 30-day sales promise; first deal timing is 4–12 months.; stages: label: Screened Opportunities; value: 1,000 distinct signal-linked firm-matter opportunities; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Deduplicate related entities and repeated anomalies before counting opportunities. Record one candidate firm and one traceable matter hypothesis per entry.; label: Corroborated Opportunities; value: 180 retained; 18.0% of initial cohort; numeric value: 180.0; detail: Retain only opportunities with independent corroboration and a plausible payment, securities, or tax nexus. Reject stale identifiers and ordinary coding variation.; label: Counsel-Screened Opportunities; value: 60 retained; 33.3% of preceding cohort; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Counsel assesses conflicts, public disclosure, source eligibility, and evidence specificity. This screen does not establish liability or entitlement to payment.; label: Scoped Support Proposals; value: 18 retained; 30.0% of preceding cohort; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Prepare priced analytical scopes with acceptance criteria, lawful access boundaries, named deliverables, payment schedules, and segregated matter permissions.; label: Paid Retainer Engagements; value: 5 retained; 27.8% of preceding cohort; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Execute five distinct annual service engagements. Track invoices and collections separately from contingent filings; no award proceeds fund payroll.

text.title: A Screening Funnel, Not an Award Forecast
text.tspan: A Screening Funnel, Not an Award Forecast

rect.title: label: Screened Opportunities; value: 1,000 distinct signal-linked firm-matter opportunities; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Deduplicate related entities and repeated anomalies before counting opportunities. Record one candidate firm and one traceable matter hypothesis per entry.

label: Corroborated Opportunities; value: 180 retained; 18.0% of initial cohort; numeric value: 180.0; detail: Retain only opportunities with independent corroboration and a plausible payment, securities, or tax nexus. Reject stale identifiers and ordinary coding variation.

label: Counsel-Screened Opportunities; value: 60 retained; 33.3% of preceding cohort; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Counsel assesses conflicts, public disclosure, source eligibility, and evidence specificity. This screen does not establish liability or entitlement to payment.

label: Scoped Support Proposals; value: 18 retained; 30.0% of preceding cohort; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Prepare priced analytical scopes with acceptance criteria, lawful access boundaries, named deliverables, payment schedules, and segregated matter permissions.

label: Paid Retainer Engagements; value: 5 retained; 27.8% of preceding cohort; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Execute five distinct annual service engagements. Track invoices and collections separately from contingent filings; no award proceeds fund payroll.

text.title: Assumptions: Synthetic mature-year cohort, not measured conversion history. All stages count distinct firm-matter opportunities, each anchored to an initial signal; later stages are subsets of earlier stages. Five engagements belong to five separate firms. No conversion stage represents an agency recovery probability.
